ev.q: death rate for children and teens aged 1–19 years caused by leukemia decreased by 33%
from 0.85 per 100,000 population in 1999 to 0.57 in 2014
brain cancer death rate fluctuated from 1999 to 2014, but remained statistically stable
For all other cancer types, death rates for children and teens aged 1–19 years declined by 23%
Sources: CDC/NCHS, National Vital Statistics System, Mortality Data
Brain cancer replaced leukemia as the leading cancer death type in 2014.

methods_quotes.q: Decline from 1999 to 2014 for leukemia and cancer of all other types was statistically significant (p<0.05).
